purpose: Advanced vector fields and reduced Hamiltonian kinematics on the existing two-torsion biological case
cases: Both first archived conformers of parent81dbd5f36b7abada; same S-N and S-aryl axes
fields: Torsional coordinate velocities, their mass-horizontal lifts, mechanical connection curvature; horizontal-lift Lie bracket is vertical
curvature_grid: 25x25 angles2*pi*j/25 over the periodic domain; fixed body section, retain all vector components and norm

trajectory.initial_velocity: positive q1 direction normalized to kinetic energy0.5kcal/mol; q2dot0
trajectory.integrator: DOP853 rtol1e-10 atol1e-12 max_step0.05; repeat rtol1e-8 atol1e-10 for convergence
trajectory.hamiltonian: 0.5 p^T g^-1 p+MMFF94s E(q), all other internal coordinates frozen
trajectory.gradient: unconstrained force-field CalcGrad after fixed-heavy hydrogen optimization; chain through exact bridge velocities; verify against energy finite differences
trajectory.rotation: Rdot=R hat(-A_i qdot_i), zero total angular momentum
trajectory.time_unit: sqrt(atomic_mass_unit Angstrom^2/(1kcal/mol per molecule)), reported in femtoseconds
trajectory.interpretation: deterministic reduced force-field model, no solvent, thermostat, receptor, full molecular dynamics or measured biological trajectory claim

checks: coordinate Hessian symmetry implies commuting chart fields
horizontal Lie-bracket curvature and small-loop sign
proper rotation residual and angular momentum cancellation
